title: Rav Hamnuna son of Rava of Pashrunya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Gittin 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.45b.6), reciting baraitot. In [Menachot 42a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.42a.23) the reading is Rav Chinena, and Hyman says this is the reading it should have, as found in [Chullin 112a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.112a.5). Hyman places him in Rava’s time.[^1]

notes.text: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1056&lang=en) records the Hamnuna form in Gittin. The consulted Menachot gives Chinena son of Rava; Chullin adds Pashrunya. Hyman prefers Chinena for the Gittin notice.
